comment_regular: Player attack-animation admission uses Oblivion behavior and preserves a compiler-specific register/FPU ABI. Bow admission requires equipped AMMO and an AttackBow group with the required Start/Attach/Hold/Release/End note contract. Rejects a new bow attack while action 5 (AttackBowArrowAttached) remains at phase <=3; an accepted bow group commits action 4 (AttackBow). This path does not automatically reload: later attack input must admit another AttackBow sequence.
